caveats: No virgin historical holdout: the Stage30 weights were selected using 2023-24; 2025-26 results have already been examined.
The 2018-22 backwards replay does not prove prospective betting ROI; strong conditions are exploratory hypotheses.
SP is used only for settlement of hypothetical unit win stakes, not to forecast horses or quantify attainable pre-off value.
Do not infer the odds available tomorrow from historic SP.
Early historical years can contain incomplete course/race classification; excluded/unknown categories are labelled.
Multiple descriptive trend comparisons increase chance findings; no automatic promotion to Model Z.
No betting selections or real-money P&L are written; full-race D rankings are research-only.
After a declared non-runner, rerun the pre-off preview. Existing rankings are never reinterpreted as updated forecasts.
If tomorrow cards are absent or races unscored, coverage marks them missing, not as no-race or no-qualifier.
